q1_issues.issue: Both arguments are bare kind-denoting plurals (wraiths / sky-cats), which is the stated trigger for an opaque kind-level relation rather than a distributing per-instance rule, so the rule as written asserts at strength 0.5 that an arbitrary wraith harms sky-cats — exactly the inference the kind-relation route exists to block.

q2_gaps: a locative restriction ('in the cove') on a relational generic whose two arguments are bare kinds — the kind-level relation form has exactly two slots and no condition slot, and ConditionalProperty is defined for kind-level properties rather than kind-level relations, so carrying the restriction and taking the licensed relational-generic route are mutually exclusive
notes: Everything else checks out: 'sometimes' set to strength 0.5 with its QuantifierPhrase companion, sky_cat fused with genus cat and the noun modifier left unexposed, and the definite 'the cove' typed at top level outside the rule.
